name: Mayfair Witches
description: An intuitive young neurosurgeon discovers that she is the unlikely heir to a family of witches. As she grapples with her newfound powers, she must contend with a sinister presence that has haunted her family for generations.

videos.title: The Witching Hour
videos.overview: Neurosurgeon Rowan Fielding has a problem - when she gets mad, she kills with her mind. Her search for answers sends her toward her secretive biological family. In New Orleans, Deirdre Mayfair is desperate to escape from her aunt's oppressive house.

videos.title: The Dark Place
videos.overview: Wracked with grief over Ellie's death, Rowan is out of control, unfit to perform surgeries. Her paranoia that someone is following her is proven true. In NOLA, Deirdre and her mysterious companion Lasher work together to draw Rowan home.

videos.title: Second Line
videos.overview: In the aftermath of Deirdre's grisly death, Rowan searches for safety in a strange city. Sip provides her with a safehouse while he investigates Deirdre's murder. Lasher makes contact with Rowan - but not in the way you might expect.

videos.title: Curiouser and Curiouser
videos.overview: At Deirdre's funeral, Rowan is plunged into the world of the infamous Mayfair family. Uncle Cortland and Aunt Carlotta present diverging views on Lasher. Rowan must choose who to trust and face the dire consequences. Sip identifies Deirdre's killer.

videos.title: The Thrall
videos.overview: Trapped in the First Street House, Rowan and Sip must confront its many mysteries in order to escape. Rowan grapples with an inconceivable offer. Sip's sister Odette makes a horrifying discovery.

videos.title: Transference
videos.overview: Desperate to relinquish Lasher, Rowan reaches out to her extended Mayfair family for help. She must trust their unique process, a sacred ritual. Sip's search for answers takes him back to the Talamasca.

videos.title: Tessa
videos.overview: Rowan makes a shocking discovery, but has to deal with it alone. A tragic event brings her closer to the Mayfairs - and Lasher. Sip falls deeper down the rabbit hole of the key necklace.

videos.title: What Rough Beast
videos.overview: Rowan inadvertently discovers her role in a prophecy that's held the Mayfair family for generations. Sip's investigation reaches its conclusion, uncovering secrets that could tarnish both Rowan's family and his role in the Talamasca.

videos.title: Lasher
videos.overview: Rowan Mayfair is determined to understand what Lasher has become. Sip is hell-bent on capturing him.

videos.title: Ten of Swords
videos.overview: Rowan must find Lasher before more people are hurt; Sip finds an ally in an angry Mayfair cousin.

videos.title: Cover the Mirrors
videos.overview: Rowan desperately partners with Cortland to try to stop Lasher. Moira assists Sip in capturing him.

videos.title: Double Helix
videos.overview: Rowan must find Lasher in order to right her wrongs. But even Sip doesn't know where Lasher is.

videos.title: Julien's Victrola
videos.overview: Rowan demands Julien's help in finding Lasher. Moira probes Cortland's mind for important memories.

videos.title: Michaelmas
videos.overview: Rowan, Moira, Cortland, and Lark search for Lasher in Scotland. Sip is questioned by the Talamasca.

videos.title: A Tangled Web
videos.overview: Rowan seeks Lasher, who joined the Scottish Mayfairs. Sip reluctantly assists the Talamasca.

videos.title: The Innocents
videos.overview: Rowan is determined to save Lasher. Cortland becomes an unlikely adversary.
